## elizaOS/eliza - 12 open issues
- #37505 Discord: a quick edit gets two replies, and the edit turn does not show what changed
- #37503 Discord: no typing indicator while the agent plans a reply
- #37500 plugin-assistant: background memory jobs write provider captures into the closed trajectory step of the user turn
- #37498 core: a cancelled turn is reported as a response-handler evaluator failure
- #37496 Discord: every message edit turn fails with "Incoming message id is bound to different or incomplete content"
- #37402 Dedicated backups: full archive, isolated restore, key custody and recurrence
- #37401 Shared iMessage: direct-message feature acceptance matrix
- #37400 Owner-consented Google (Gmail/Calendar): live consent, read, send and revocation acceptance
- #37399 Shared iMessage latency: measure hot/cold provider phases and enable bounded diagnostic capture
- #37398 Cloud phone sign-in: pass a real-expiry continuity cycle and resolve the phone-to-email account switch
- #37397 Shared iMessage: current-news request gets 'I couldn't verify current news from these sources.' and drops the weather answer
- #35132 Shared iMessage: OpenRouter fallback returns 401 after Cerebras 429

## SlopDotCash/slopdotcash - 17 open issues
- #1224 Pending stored bindings are re-broadcast without re-reading D1, so an abandoned old wallet can still be paid
- #1047 Complete free Slopbot automation and exception handling
- #1046 Use one Points policy and credit useful reviews
- #914 Track the streamlined MVP and its release evidence
- #912 Finish exception-focused inbox and email delivery
- #911 Pause on two contributor flags and restore after a clean scan
- #910 Automate private reports and simplify discretionary bounty awards
- #909 Automate a bounded malicious-code scan and skill publication
- #908 Make project setup and owner updates self-service
- #905 Convert received project-token fees to USDC with an owner-controlled signer
- #904 Complete self-service vaults and authorized automatic monthly payouts
- #902 Verify complete funding and payout flows on the four test networks
- #901 Deploy and verify the reviewed escrow on Solana mainnet
- #900 Deploy and verify the reviewed escrow on Ethereum mainnet
- #899 Deploy and verify the reviewed escrow on Robinhood Chain mainnet
- #898 Deploy and verify the reviewed escrow on Base mainnet
- #640 Verify simplified user journeys and free Slopbot operation
